caption_used: 该折线图展示了Teacher、Self-Training和PST三种方法在不同漏标率条件下的F1得分变化。横轴为漏标率，范围从0到0.585；纵轴为F1得分，范围从52.5到72.5。绿色实线带圆形标记代表PST方法，在所有漏标率下均表现最优。红色实线带圆形标记代表Teacher方法，蓝色实线带方形标记代表Self-Training方法。在漏标率为0时，三种方法起点相近，PST约72.2、Teacher约72.0、Self-Training约70.0。随着漏标率增加至0.3，Teacher的F1降至约66.5，而Self-Training降至约65.5。值得注意的是，当漏标率超过0.4后，Teacher和Self-Training两者的衰减速度趋于一致，在漏标率为0.585时几乎收敛至同一水平约54.0，而PST在该点仍维持约80.0的较高水平，展现出显著的鲁棒性优势。

The figure is a line chart displaying the F1 scores of three methods—Teacher, Self-Training, and PST—across varying levels of missing label rates. The x-axis is labeled “漏标率” (missing label rate) and ranges from 0 to 0.585 with uniform intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “F1” and ranges from 52.5 to 72.5 with uniform intervals of 1.0. There are three data series represented by lines: a blue line with square markers representing “Self-Training”, a red line with circular markers representing “Teacher”, and a green line with circular markers representing “PST”. The green line (PST) starts at approximately 72.2 at a missing label rate of 0 and decreases to approximately 68.5 at a missing label rate of 0.585. The red line (Teacher) begins at approximately 72.0 at a missing label rate of 0 and declines to approximately 54.0 at a missing label rate of 0.585. The blue line (Self-Training) starts at approximately 70.0 at a missing label rate of 0 and decreases to approximately 52.5 at a missing label rate of 0.585.
